Whirlpool has 2 manufacturers & 2 designs for this one product!! Whirlpool gets a 1 star for that, but when you get the correct design for your fridge, I give it 5 stars for filtering & faster water flow!
Just to help clarify...Whirlpool has 2 manufacturers for this Filter #5 that replaces discontinued 4396508.
I learned this from another review on here that posted Whirlpool's Customer Service Rep's response.
Because of Whirlpool's 2 manufacturers, I did not risk ordering my filter online, but went to my local Lowes where they had BOTH Everydrop #5 filters from the 2 manufacturers! For my 2005 fridge, I needed the Kemflo design with the flat top with notches cut into it (as pictured above in the one pack photo & from abed's one star review photo labeled "old model" --you can see the notches cut into the right side). The other #5 design was rounded on top (no notches) and manufactured by Mexico 1 (and is pictured in abed's review labeled "new model"). It's pretty poor that Whirlpool has 2 designs listed under the same part number (Everydrop 5) & even if you order directly from Whirlpool they cannot tell you which design will ship! The Whirlpool rep said that older model fridges (8-10 years old) need the filter made for Whirlpool by Kemflo in Taiwan that is flat with the notches in it. So, look at your current filter to see what you need! Then you will at least know which manufacturer design you need. Hope this is helpful for others!

I have purchased a few of these filters before and they seemed to work ok, though price continues to go up. I recently installed one from a two pack that I bought on Amazon and the flow was very poor. When I tested the water coming for total dissolved solids (TDS), it measured in the 180's, though the tap water was only in the 150's. I replaced this filter with the second filter and things got better, though TDS was still in the 90's. I called the toll free number on the packing to see about getting a replacement and they (Whirlpool) said that I had to return to Amazon, since I bought it from them. When I pressed them about the return, they insinuated that Amazon is not actually authorized to sell their products (I have a hard time believing that) and if I want to have my products warranted, I had to buy from them. Unfortunately for me, I had bought these for several months in advance of needing them, so my return window with Amazon was closed.

Bottom line on this filter: There are likely others that work as well or better for less, but if you decide to buy them, buy them one at a time and install them before your Amazon return window closes. Hope this helps!

The light on my refrigerator turned yellow so I placed an order with Amazon for these filters on January 30, 2017. The light stays yellow for a month and I replace it when it turns red. I believe I replaced this around the beginning of March 2017. A couple of weeks ago, I noticed a substantial reduction in water flow. It was taking a very long time just to fill a coffee pot. Last weekend, at the end of April, I replaced the filter with the second one. The first one barely lasted two months, and that includes a week or two of poor water flow.

I contacted the manufacturer today and explained the situation to them. They told me to contact the vendor for a refund. I told them I purchased it from Amazon and I am beyond the return period. I asked them if they guarantee these filters and they said they do when purchased directly from them. I explained how ludicrous that is. I compared it to purchasing a brand name television from a big box store that breaks six months later. The television manufacturer will still repair or replace it. This manufacturer told me they could not verify that I purchased an authentic filter. I told them I did purchase an authentic filter directly from Amazon and I offered to ship it back to them at my expense. They told me they are not setup for that and the best they could offer is a discount on a replacement filter. The discount was less than 20 percent off the full retail price so I told them no thank you.

Follow up: May 30, 2017<

I just received the filter today. It gets 4 stars out the gate. In order to get the fifth star, it actually has to work for a while. I checked the Whirlpool site for my model refrigerator. The former filter part was UKF8001. The new filter part is EDR4RXD1. I ordered EDR4RXD2, which includes 2 of the filters. The old UKF8001 took a bit of twisting to get out. I do this infrequently, and I guess the plastic in the filter had bonded to the rubber and plastic in the refrigerator holding assembly. Finding the right amount of force took me a minute. I had pre-filled the new filter with water. Neither the manual nor the YouTube video say to do that, but I read another Amazon review where someone mentioned having done so, and it made sense.

I almost bought aftermarket, but there were mixed reviews, including some discussion about problematic rubber gaskets. So, I bought the genuine CGP (Certified Genuine Part). The new filter went in just fine. The water flowed clear and strong. I ran about 2.5 gallons of water through the water dispenser. The manual says to run for 2 minutes. The water flowed clear for the entire 2.5 gallons.

So far so good. Everything is working.
